full_prompt_en: A square painterly fantasy illustration centers on a slim orange bird perched amid tall grasses and drifting leaves. The bird turns left with a sharply pointed dark beak, its warm body standing out against a deep teal-blue field. Around it, golden light spills from the upper left and blends into turquoise, jade, and shadowed navy. Thin stems arc diagonally across the scene; small leaves and seed forms float at several depths. Below, broad pale gray-white brush swirls suggest foliage, stone, or moving air rather than a precisely drawn setting. The composition has a vertical lift from the lower pale marks up to the bird and bright opening. Color is applied in translucent layers, soft smudges, and occasional sharp flicks, making some edges vivid and others nearly lost. A few tiny warm accents repeat the bird's orange elsewhere in the frame, binding it to the environment. The lighting feels internal and atmospheric, with the brightest yellow-green area behind the bird and dark teal closing in at the right. The whole image is lyrical and spontaneous, closer to an expressive nature painting than a natural-history plate. Its character comes from flowing brush motion, complementary color, and partially abstract space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画性奇幻插画以一只纤细橙鸟为中心，它停在高草和飘动叶片之间。鸟向左转，黑色尖喙明确，温暖身体从深青蓝色域前跳出。周围金光从左上漫入，并与青绿、翡翠和深海军蓝阴影相融。细茎斜向弯过画面，小叶与种子状形体分布在多个深度。下方宽阔浅灰白笔刷旋纹暗示叶丛、石头或流动空气，而不是精确描画的地点。构图由下方浅色笔迹向鸟和明亮开口垂直抬升。颜色以透明层、柔和擦抹和偶尔尖利短笔施加，使某些边缘鲜明、另一些几乎消失。几处微小暖色点在画内重复鸟的橙色，把它连进环境。光显得从内部发出且富于空气感，鸟后是最亮黄绿区，右侧由深青收拢。整体抒情而自发，更像表现性自然画而非博物学图版。气质来自流动笔势、互补颜色和局部抽象空间。
style_prompt_en: An expressive nature-painting language layers translucent teal, jade, navy, gold, and one vivid orange focal accent. Broad soft smudges and sweeping pale brush curves create an ambiguous environment, while a few crisp thin stems and small forms retain visual focus. Edges alternate between sharp flicks and near disappearance. Light seems to bloom inside the color field, brightest near the focal accent and darkening toward one side. Diagonal organic lines and upward motion give the composition lift. The surface remains painterly and spontaneous, with layered pigment and partial abstraction carrying a lyrical mood.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性自然绘画语言层叠透明深青、翡翠、海军蓝、金色和一处鲜橙焦点。宽阔柔和擦痕与浅色弧形笔刷构成边界不明的环境，少数清晰细茎与小形体保留视觉焦点。边缘在尖利短笔与近乎消失之间交替。亮光仿佛在色域内部绽开，焦点附近最亮，向一侧逐渐压暗。有机斜线和向上动势使构图抬升。表面保持绘画感和自发性，由层叠颜料与部分抽象承载抒情气氛。
theme_en: A vivid orange bird appears among sweeping teal and gold abstract foliage
theme_zh: 一只鲜橙色小鸟出现在深青与金色流动抽象叶丛中
name: Anne Bachelier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
